AboutPage.meta_description: Ateliers 360 makes technology accessible to young people through hands-on workshops in robotics, programming and science.
AboutPage.hero_subtitle: Ateliers 360 designs and runs hands-on workshops to introduce young people to science, programming and robotics.
AboutPage.mission_text: Making technology tangible and inclusive: we design playful and educational workshops that allow young people to understand, create and appropriate digital and scientific tools.
AboutPage.values_subtitle: The principles that guide our approach
AboutPage.value1_desc: Formats designed for all levels, without technical prerequisites.
AboutPage.value2_desc: Learning through realization: concrete projects and visible results.
AboutPage.value3_desc: Encouraging exploration and critical thinking towards technology.
AboutPage.value4_desc: Raising awareness about ethical and responsible use of technology.
AboutPage.approach_intro: We combine active pedagogy, adapted tools and accompaniment to guarantee a motivating and durable learning experience.
AboutPage.approach1_desc: Short sequences and progressive for adapting to learning paces.
AboutPage.approach2_desc: Each workshop leads to a tangible realization (robot, prototype, application).
AboutPage.approach3_desc: Adapted methods to welcome the diversity of profiles and needs.
AboutPage.approach4_desc: Collaboration with schools, associations and local actors to maximize the impact.
AboutPage.approach5_desc: Continuous feedback to adjust the content and measure the learning outcomes.
AboutPage.founder_bio: Developer, entrepreneur and pedagogue, Nathan is holder of a DUT GEII and has been running tech and science workshops for young people for several years. With a concrete experience with Fusion Jeunesse, he designs paths combining robotics, programming and AI initiation to make technology accessible and motivating.
AboutPage.alternant_bio: Student in an internship program, she will accompany the design and animation of workshops, bringing a fresh perspective on digital mediation and pedagogical formats adapted to young audiences.
AboutPage.team_member1_desc: We're looking for someone passionate about animation and pedagogy to design and lead our workshops.
AboutPage.team_member2_desc: A scientific profile with a passion for sharing and explaining science.
AboutPage.team_member3_desc: A technology expert who wants to share their passion for technology and innovation.
AboutPage.team_member4_desc: A versatile profile in communication, project management or partnership development.
AboutPage.impact_subtitle: Tailored workshops for young people with disabilities
AboutPage.impact1_desc: We develop inclusive formats to welcome young people with disabilities, ensuring equal participation.
AboutPage.impact2_desc: Our interventions target rural areas and priority zones to reduce the digital divide.
AboutPage.impact3_desc: Our workshops encourage young women to explore STEM careers with specialized support.
AboutPage.vision_text: Reach 120+ workshops and 2000+ young people supported, consolidating our local partnerships and social impact.
AboutPage.cta_subtitle: Contact us to organize a session or learn more about our formats.

CgvPage.article3_desc: Ateliers 360 provides two complementary activity areas.
